A '''planet''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was where the [[Rebel stronghold]] was located and [[Battle of the Rebel stronghold|destroyed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial forces]] under the command of, then, [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]].

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was shown in the introductory cutscene, however, it had not been given an official name.
